about: Kit A/B 0.2 for Digitakt OS 1.54: the author's released .elemod file, pinned unchanged.

mods.title: Kit A/B
mods.summary: Ten Digitakt MKI mods: new LFO waves with pictures, a looping random LFO, Kit A/B, Ctrl All, real units, mute snapshots, track solo, velocity humanise and Euclidean accents.
mods.description: Kit A/B, after the Analog Rytm mod: hold TRK and press NO to hear the active pattern's temp-saved kit (B, what FUNC+NO would bring back) while your edited kit (A) is kept aside; TRK+NO again brings your edits back. The temp copy is never overwritten, so FUNC+YES and FUNC+NO work as before. A small B shows in the top-right corner while B plays. Changing pattern while B plays puts your edits back into the pattern you left.
mods.author: Cere, made with Claude
mods.on_unit: All ten tested together on a real Digitakt MKI (OS 1.54) with core and seq-events: LFO waves and pictures, Deja Vu loops and destinations, Kit A/B, Ctrl All, real-unit displays, mute snapshots, track solo, humanise, Euclid accents and the MOD SETTINGS row. OS 1.53 not supported.
